purpose: Bounded single-use browser/state/binding proof for gateway login
baselineEvidence: Final verified #110 source snapshot, scanned before commit while HEAD was a94f602; source now committed as 1817fcc

verification.nativeScope: Actual transaction class, synthetic loopback HTTPS browser flow; no real identity/control-plane/code redemption/upstream/AWS
verification.database: Not repeated locally; unchanged policy/database code verified by #110 with 100 PostgreSQL tests and passing CI

limitations: Single-process ephemeral state; restart requires fresh login and replicas require shared state or guaranteed affinity.
Only the latest pending login on a host can finish after its nonce rotates; earlier tabs restart.
Bounded retained entries are not public admission/rate limits.
Confirmation UI, callback HTTP validation, redemption transport, app-session cookies and customer proxy remain subsequent integration.
Full repository >=95 and complete-feature production gates remain unmet.
